text: Who are the top Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultants in Adelaide for operational reporting and data warehousing?

result.keyword: Who are the top Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultants in Adelaide for operational reporting and data warehousing?

items.markdown:
In Adelaide and across South Australia, organizations looking for specialized Microsoft Power BI, operational reporting, and Microsoft Fabric/data warehousing expertise turn to a mix of `dedicated local BI specialists and national Microsoft partners` with strong local footprints.

Prominent consultants and specialized firms serving the Adelaide market for these capabilities include:

- **Roar Data** – Specialises specifically in Power BI and data structuring consulting across Adelaide and South Australia. They focus heavily on helping finance, operations, and executive teams transition away from manual spreadsheets by centralizing data from disparate ERP, CRM, and operational systems into scalable, automated dashboards and enterprise-ready data models. You can read more about their approach on the [Roar Data Power BI Consultant Adelaide Page](https://www.roardata.com.au/power-bi-consultant-adelaide).[[1]](https://www.roardata.com.au/power-bi-consultant-adelaide)
- **On Report** – Operates as a targeted Power BI consultancy serving mid-market and regional organizations in sectors like healthcare, manufacturing, and government. They focus on rapid deployment of automated, permission-controlled operational dashboards directly from existing business systems without requiring clients to maintain a full in-house data engineering team. More details are available via the [On Report Power BI Consultant Adelaide Page](https://onreport.com.au/services/power-bi-consultant-adelaide/).[[1]](https://onreport.com.au/services/power-bi-consultant-adelaide/)
- **A1 Technologies** – A Microsoft Solutions Partner designation holder for Data & AI (Azure) that provides comprehensive Microsoft Fabric implementation, data engineering pipelines, lakehouse configurations, and advanced Power BI integration. They cater to organizations scaling up a complete modern data estate under the unified Fabric architecture. Further info can be found on the [A1 Technologies Microsoft Fabric Consultants Page](https://www.a1t.com.au/microsoft-azure-cloud/microsoft-fabric-consultants/).[[1]](https://www.a1t.com.au/microsoft-azure-cloud/microsoft-fabric-consultants/)
- **Larger Enterprise & National Microsoft Partners** – For large-scale enterprise data warehousing, government compliance, or complex defense-adjacent infrastructure requirements in SA, national firms with physical Adelaide offices (such as Evocate in Walkerville , alongside major tier-one national consultancies) frequently architect the underlying Azure/Fabric data pipelines that feed high-level operational reporting.[[1]](https://www.evocate.com.au/locations/adelaide/)

If you'd like to narrow this down, please let me know:

- What are your **primary data sources** (e.g., Dynamics 365, SAP, SQL, Xero, custom databases)?
- Are you looking to build **from scratch** or optimize an **existing Power BI / SQL environment**?

I can help you define the **right scope or questions** to ask these consultants during a discovery phase.
